authority: ROOT fresh matcher correction plus ONE versioned existing-record acquisition; old NO_EXACT_MATCH unchanged
filenameProfile: UTC or America/Chicago(CDT UTC-05) only as coarse name filter; header launch/capture times authoritative. Other names never retained or logged.
headerMatch: Exact integerPID17408 plus crash-schema309 captureTime with explicit offset/Z inside [historicalStart-120000,historicalFinish+120000]. No expected-image, launch-time or parent predicate. Missing/ambiguous event timestamp => STOP; no metadata-timestamp fallback.
recordPublication: Predicate flags for all inspected candidates; exact PID/timestamp/image/termination only for PID+window matches. Actual process path is discovery, not expected-path admission. No raw record/header publication.
stop: No match/denied/ambiguous/oversized/integrity/capture/retirement => STOP; no other directories/logs/process probes
eventFieldQualification: Apple IPS captureTime denotes crash/event time; metadata timestamp is tracking time; procLaunch recorded only after exactPID/window match.
